items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: She wrote a newsletter for the — St. Petersburg Florida — she says “Jack, we can’t wait for you to come down for the cruise. So she wrote down for the newsletter she was on that cruise with Oscar Peterson.

ctx.x: Oh, there’s so many good people going to be there, oh, Lord.

Yeah. In fact I got a letter from a lady from Florida, she’s a real fan of ours now. She wrote a newsletter for the — St. Petersburg Florida — she says “Jack, we can’t wait for you to come down for the cruise. So she wrote down for the newsletter she was on that cruise with Oscar Peterson. She wrote some of the report on that.
Oh, I was on that cruise.
